vision: A distributable library of AI agent rules, skills, and hooks with a file-based adversarial harness — health audit cycle remediating two dead hooks, five undocumented rules, and a harness-gate blind spot for short prompts.

tasks.name: Fix harness-gate glue threshold to catch short feature prompts
tasks.scope: library/cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh + .cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh. Raise glue threshold from 25 to 50 chars OR add word-count heuristic (>=4 words = non-glue). Done when 'refatora tudo', 'migra o banco', 'adiciona autenticação' each trigger routing advice in a unit test run.

tasks.name: Fire skill-suggest on every prompt, not just sessionStart
tasks.scope: library/cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh + .cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh. Add skill-suggest.py invocation to beforeSubmitPrompt so suggestions appear for all messages, not just the first. Done when running harness-gate.sh with a skill-triggering prompt returns SKILL SUGGESTIONS block in followup_message.
